component.name: core.openwop.workflows.knowledge
component.description: Real-work workflow pack (RFC 0013, ADR 0190 Phase 2) — the internal Knowledge cluster: employee policy/HR Q&A grounded in your Knowledge Base, compliance review of documents against your policy corpus, and structured document summarization. Distinct from core.openwop.workflows.support: these serve EMPLOYEES over internal policy collections. Authored over shipped node typeIds (feature.kb.nodes.rag + core.ai.chatCompletion + core.flow.if + core.chat.approvalGate + core.openwop.integration.*). Populate the collections in the Knowledge feature — these chains READ the app KB. All tenant values are run parameters (replay-deterministic). EVERY delivery edge is PORT-QUALIFIED (ADR 0583) — a bare edge binds no named port at all. Every external send waits on a human approval gate AND ONLY FIRES ON AN APPROVAL — Slack takes its content BACK OFF THE GATE (`approveEscalation.artifact → escalate.text`, `{truthy approved}`), so it has NO unconditional incoming edge and every non-approving outcome folds it to `skipped`.
